correctness.rationale: PASS: For each nonnegative input the six output maxima over radius 0,1,2 are the maximum of 3^6 linear row-average operators in squared l2 norm. Nonnegative matrices permit extending the supremum to their top singular values for arbitrary real inputs. The source integer Sylvester certificate chooses B=30A and H=1269I-B^TB; I independently reconstructed all 729 exact integer matrices and checked six exact leading principal minors for every selection: 726 strictly positive definite and precisely three antipodal-pair radius-0/radius-1 exceptions. The latter reduce to 2x2 block [[1,0],[sqrt(8)/5,3/5]] with squared top singular value (21+6 sqrt(6))/25>141/100. Orthogonal antisymmetric and low-zero-sum modes give singular values 1 and 1/5, so top eigenspace is simple. At g=(1,1,(sqrt(6)-2)/2 repeated four times), active-radius inequalities and exact Gram eigenvector give attainment and all three nonnegative rays; independent coordinate signs are harmless under |f|.
